teaser: web-summit.sgit.ai: one site where six people and their agents ran Web Summit, in four layers built on git.
core_idea: The Web Summit team ran its week from one site built from markdown and data in git: briefs, onboarding levels and a command centre for each person; keys, inbox lanes and sealed secrets for each agent; the board as 219 files; and the outside world as a company map, an X-ray and a CRM in public and private vaults. Files serve agents and people alike, and keys make private channels small steps.

nodes.label: The reality file
nodes.summary: Fell behind in the busiest days.

quotes.text: Once every agent had a public key, private channels, secrets and signatures were all small steps.
An agent reads 219 board items faster than it can click through any tool.
a thing that is not written down in its REALITY file does not exist, whatever a brief says
